# Tyler White

> Tyler White is a Director of Product Design based in Montreal with 16 years in product design, and the creator of the Builder Kickoff™. He writes about how product designers scope the right problem, build the business case for design, and prove what design is worth: PRDs, kickoffs, case studies, UX metrics and AI workflows for designers.

## Letters

- [What Is a PRD?](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/what-is-a-prd/): What a product requirements document is, what goes in one, who writes it and how it differs from a BRD, brief and spec.
- [PRD Template](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/prd-template/): A free, copy-paste PRD template and how to fill it from one kickoff meeting.
- [PRD vs BRD](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/prd-vs-brd/): What each document covers, who owns it, and why most teams need only one.
- [Product Brief and Design Brief Template](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/product-brief-template/): A free product brief template plus the design brief questions that matter.
- [Project Kickoff Meeting Agenda](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/project-kickoff-meeting/): A 60-minute kickoff agenda that forces real decisions.
- [Design Rationale](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/design-rationale/): How to write and present design rationale, with a reusable decision record format.
- [UX Case Study Template](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ux-case-study-template/): A free case study template structured around decisions and outcomes.
- [UX Case Study Examples](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ux-case-study-examples/): What strong case studies that prove impact have in common.
- [UX Metrics](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ux-metrics/): The UX metrics and KPIs leadership cares about, and how to estimate impact without perfect data.
- [Product Designer Portfolio Homepage](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/product-designer-portfolio/): How to structure a portfolio homepage that sells.
- [Product Designer Salary 2026](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/product-designer-salary/): US and Canada salary ranges by level, and the skills that move pay.
- [AI Prototyping Workflow](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ai-prototyping-workflow/): A real AI prototyping workflow for product designers, prompt included.
- [Cursor for Designers](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/cursor-for-designers/): Why Tyler moved from Figma Make to Cursor for product prototypes.
- [All Letters](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/): The full archive.

## Products and free resources

- [Builder Kickoff™ Course](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/builder-kickoff/): A 20-minute recorded course on running the session that turns a business problem into a scoped decision, then a PRD and a prototype prompt.
- [The 15 Minute Case Study](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/roi-case-study-template/): A free Claude skill that turns rough project notes into a case study.
- [The Funnel Simulator](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/funnel-simulator/): A free Claude skill that builds a funnel simulator for a SaaS product.
- [The ROI of Design Newsletter](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/newsletter/): A weekly newsletter on scoping, framing and building the business case for design work.

## Podcast

- [The Design Table Podcast](https://www.youtube.com/@designtablepodcast): Podcast co-hosted by Tyler White and Nick Groeneveld on product design careers, AI workflows and practice. Episodes are also embedded in the related letters.
